items.title: Importance of Teamwork and Communication in Digital Environments (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Importance of Teamwork and Communication in Digital Environments (PDF 129, printed 125).

blocks.text: Digital mahol mein teamwork ke liye team members ke darmiyan wazeh communication aur bharosa zaroori hai. Jab har koi khayalat deta hai aur doosron ki sunta hai to projects aasani se chalte hain. Mo-assar communication ghalat-fehmiyan rokti hai aur yaqeeni banati hai ke sab members progress se bakhabar rahein. Group chats, emails aur video calls jaise tools teams ko jura rakhte hain. Achha teamwork maqsad hasil karne mein creativity, taawun aur mushtarka zimmedari barhata hai.

blocks.prompt: Digital teams ko jura rakhne wale teen tools batayein, aur achhi communication ka aik faida.
blocks.explanation: Group chats, emails aur video calls. Achhi communication ghalat-fehmiyan rokti hai aur sab ko kaam ki pragati (progress) se aagah rakhti hai.

items: Digital teamwork: wazeh communication aur bharosa.
Group chats, emails, video calls; creativity aur shared zimmedari.
